matching_prs.title: Add a check script: types, type-check and dry-run bundle
matching_prs.classification: Verification approach for a demo with no test suite
matching_prs.weakness: A clean checkout had no reproducible type-and-bundle check. The base tsconfig.json required ./worker-configuration.d.ts, which .gitignore excluded and the base tree did not contain.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Added a manual npm run check that generates Worker types, runs the TypeScript compiler, and bundles using Wrangler's dry run.
diff_evidence: package.json adds "check": "wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run" alongside the existing cf-typegen script.
README adds a paragraph stating the repository has no tests and describing the type and bundle checks. The PR changed these two files only.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Generate ignored prerequisites within the clean-checkout verification command, and document which build steps it exercises and which runtime behavior still needs evidence.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged 2026-10-11. The author reported a clean run, a failing run with a deliberately invalid StoredData change, and a passing run after reverting. The PR head had zero GitHub check runs and zero commit statuses. The dry run bundles the Worker without executing the Durable Object.

limitations: No test case was changed or deleted. This PR qualifies as a deliberate change to the verification approach. The author's local commands were not independently rerun.
